title: RBI Amendment Directions on 'Matters to be Placed Before the Boards of Banks'
description: <cite index="27-3,56-3">Four parallel Amendment Directions were issued on July 14, 2026 — one each for Commercial Banks, Small Finance Banks (SFBs), Payments Banks, and Local Area Banks (LABs) — replacing the 'seven broad themes' with principle-based governance guidance, effective from October 1, 2026.</cite>
